bookings_live_quote_uq.name: bookings_live_quote_uq
bookings_live_quote_uq.where: status <> 'cancelled' and quote_id is not null

event_invitations_open_uq.name: event_invitations_open_uq
event_invitations_open_uq.where: accepted_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL

gifts_giver_ck.name: gifts_giver_ck
gifts_giver_ck.value: "gifts"."household_id" is not null or "gifts"."giver_name" is not null

quote_lines_scope_ck.name: quote_lines_scope_ck
quote_lines_scope_ck.value: ("quote_lines"."scope" = 'requirement' and "quote_lines"."requirement_id" is not null and "quote_lines"."service_id" is not null) or ("quote_lines"."scope" = 'service' and "quote_lines"."requirement_id" is null and "quote_lines"."service_id" is not null) or ("quote_lines"."scope" = 'package' and "quote_lines"."requirement_id" is null and "quote_lines"."service_id" is null)

threads_kind_ck.name: threads_kind_ck
threads_kind_ck.value: ("threads"."kind" = 'team' and "threads"."vendor_id" is null and "threads"."function_id" is null) or ("threads"."kind" = 'vendor' and "threads"."vendor_id" is not null and "threads"."function_id" is null) or ("threads"."kind" = 'function' and "threads"."function_id" is not null and "threads"."vendor_id" is null)
